intro: 大足石刻位于重庆市大足区，以宝顶山、北山摩崖造像最为著名，儒释道造像并存，雕刻细腻，题材丰富，是世界文化遗产，堪称中国晚期石窟艺术的代表。
review_tags: ['遛娃宝藏地', '亲子同乐', '历史建筑']
name_aliases: ['大足石刻', 'Dazu Rock Carvings']
review_summary: 大足石刻景区是遛娃宝藏地，可以欣赏历史建筑，适合亲子同乐，是带孩子出游、共享欢乐时光的好去处。
intro_en: The Dazu Rock Carvings are located in Dazu District, Chongqing. The cliffside sculptures at Baodingshan and Beishan are the most famous. Featuring coexisting Confucian, Buddhist, and Taoist statues, exquisite carvings, and rich subject matter, they are a UNESCO World Heritage Site and can be regarded as a representative of China's late-period grotto art.
address_en: Dazu Rock Carvings Scenic Area, Dazu District
review_summary_en:
Location: Dazu Rock Carvings Scenic Area, Dazu District
The Dazu Rock Carvings Scenic Area is a hidden gem for taking kids out. Visitors can admire historic architecture, and it is perfect for family fun—an ideal destination for traveling with children and sharing joyful moments together.

address: 重庆市大足区宝顶镇地藏殿
intro: 大足石刻数字影院位于重庆大足石刻景区，通过数字化影像技术展示大足石刻的历史与艺术魅力，是游客了解这一世界文化遗产的重要窗口。
intro_en: The Dazu Rock Carvings Digital Cinema is located in the Dazu Rock Carvings Scenic Area in Chongqing. Through digital imaging technology, it showcases the history and artistic charm of the Dazu Rock Carvings, serving as an important window for visitors to learn about this World Cultural Heritage site.

address: 重庆市大足区龙岗街道韦君靖碑大足石刻名胜风景区北山石刻
intro: 大足石刻位于中国西南部重庆市大足区境内，是唐末宋初时期的摩崖石刻，以佛教题材为主，其中以宝顶山摩崖造像和北山摩崖造像最为著名。大足石刻是中国著名的古代石刻艺术，1999年被列为世界文化遗产，其组成部分宝顶山摩崖造像、北山摩崖造像于1961年分别入选全国重点文物保护单位。
review_tags: ['遛娃宝藏地', '亲子同乐', '历史建筑']
intro_en: The Dazu Rock Carvings are located in Dazu District, Chongqing, in southwest China. They are cliff carvings dating from the late Tang to early Song dynasties, mainly featuring Buddhist themes, among which the Baodingshan Cliff Carvings and Beishan Cliff Carvings are the most famous. The Dazu Rock Carvings are renowned ancient stone carving art in China and were listed as a World Cultural Heritage site in 1999. Their components, the Baodingshan Cliff Carvings and Beishan Cliff Carvings, were respectively designated as Major Historical and Cultural Sites Protected at the National Level in 1961.
address_en: Beishan Grottoes, Dazu Rock Carvings Scenic Area, Longgang Subdistrict, Dazu District, Chongqing, China

address: 中华人民共和国上海吴淞口国际邮轮港(T1候船楼进港)
intro: 上海淞沪抗战纪念公园原名宝山临江公园，是位于上海市宝山区的一座公园，公园建成于1956年，是在清代宝山庙宇古建筑原址和周边土山基础上，由宝山县和上海市北郊区的团员青年，通过义务劳动的方式而建立。最初定名为“共青公园”。建成同年8月，改名为“友谊公园”，后因园区濒临长江，于1962年改名为“临江公园” 。2015年6月更名為上海淞沪抗战纪念公园 。
intro_en:
Location: Shanghai Songhu Anti-Japanese War Memorial Park

Shanghai Songhu Anti-Japanese War Memorial Park was originally named Baoshan Linjiang Park. It is a park located in Baoshan District, Shanghai. The park was completed in 1956, built on the original site of ancient temple buildings from the Qing Dynasty in Baoshan and the surrounding earthen hills, through voluntary labor by young members of the Communist Youth League from Baoshan County and the northern suburbs of Shanghai. It was initially named "Gongqing Park." In August of the same year it was completed, it was renamed "Friendship Park," and later, because the park is close to the Yangtze River, it was renamed "Linjiang Park" in 1962. In June 2015, it was renamed Shanghai Songhu Anti-Japanese War Memorial Park.

intro: 武汉国民政府旧址，即南洋大楼，位于中华人民共和国湖北省武汉市江汉区中山大道708号，由主楼和副楼两部分组成，主楼是一座五层钢筋混凝土框架结构的建筑。该建筑建成于1921年，原为南洋兄弟烟草公司的经营者简照南、简照强兄弟所建，1926年12月至1927年3月间将主楼借予武汉国民政府作为办公用楼。此后该楼几经外借，1951年起由武汉市财政经济委员会管理。1988年，楼内第三层恢复了武汉国民政府时期的部分陈设，并作为展览对外开放。1996年，武汉国民政府旧址被列为全国重点文物保护单位。
name_aliases: ['南洋大楼']
intro_en:
Site: Former Site of the Wuhan Nationalist Government

The Former Site of the Wuhan Nationalist Government, namely the Nanyang Building, is located at No. 708 Zhongshan Avenue, Jianghan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province, People's Republic of China. It consists of two parts, a main building and an annex, with the main building being a five-story reinforced concrete frame structure. Completed in 1921, the building was originally built by Jian Zhaonan and Jian Zhaoqiang, brothers who ran the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Company. From December 1926 to March 1927, the main building was lent to the Wuhan Nationalist Government for use as its office. The building was subsequently lent out several times, and from 1951 it was administered by the Wuhan Municipal Finance and Economics Committee. In 1988, part of the third floor was restored with furnishings from the period of the Wuhan Nationalist Government and opened to the public as an exhibition. In 1996, the Former Site of the Wuhan Nationalist Government was listed as a Major Historical and Cultural Site Protected at the National Level.

intro: 汉口新四军军部旧址位于湖北省武汉市江岸区胜利街332-352号，是新四军第一个军部所在地。汉口新四军军部挂牌地点是原汉口大和街26号，抗日战争中被炸毁。存留下来的是34-44号两栋房子，即今胜利街332-352号。军部不仅有办公开会的地方，还有训练、招待之所。2002年12月25日，新四军军部旧址被选为湖北省文物保护单位。2005年由武汉市人民政府拨款修复。2006年12月25日纪念馆开馆。 2013年3月5日被选为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
name_aliases: ['汉口新四军军部旧址纪念馆']
intro_en: The Former Site of the New Fourth Army Headquarters in Hankou is located at Nos. 332-352 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province, and was the site of the New Fourth Army's first headquarters. The New Fourth Army headquarters in Hankou was originally at No. 26 Daiwa Street, Hankou, which was destroyed by bombing during the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression. What remains are two buildings at Nos. 34-44, now Nos. 332-352 Shengli Street. The headquarters had not only offices and meeting rooms but also facilities for training and receiving guests. On December 25, 2002, the former site of the New Fourth Army Headquarters was designated a Hubei Province Cultural Relics Protection Unit. In 2005, the Wuhan Municipal People's Government allocated funds for its restoration, and the memorial hall opened on December 25, 2006. On March 5, 2013, it was designated one of the seventh batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units.

intro: 上海宋庆龄故居位于上海市徐汇区淮海中路1843号，是中华人民共和国名誉主席宋庆龄于1948年以后在上海的住所。该住所最早由一名希腊船主于二十世纪二十年代修建，后来为朱博泉所购，抗日战争结束后被南京国民政府收归国有，并于1948年拨给宋庆龄居住。该房屋为砖木混凝土结构，外形为船型假三层。2001年，上海宋庆龄故居被列为全国重点文物保护单位。
name_aliases: ['宋庆龄故居', '上海宋庆龄故居']
intro_en: The Shanghai Soong Ching-ling Memorial Residence is located at 1843 Huaihai Middle Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai. It was the Shanghai residence of Soong Ching-ling, Honorary President of the People's Republic of China, after 1948. The house was first built in the 1920s by a Greek shipowner, later purchased by Zhu Boquan, and was nationalized by the Nanjing Nationalist Government after the end of the War of Resistance Against Japan. In 1948 it was allocated to Soong Ching-ling as her residence. The building is of brick-timber-concrete construction, with a ship-shaped, pseudo-three-story exterior. In 2001, the Shanghai Soong Ching-ling Memorial Residence was listed as a Major Historical and Cultural Site Protected at the National Level.

Once the seat of the CPC Central Committee, it is hailed as the sacred land of the Chinese revolution and is a renowned red tourism destination.

intro: 武汉二七纪念馆，是位于中华人民共和国湖北省武汉市江岸区解放大道2499号的一座社会科学类历史专题纪念馆。纪念馆开办于1960年2月7日，毗邻江岸站、江岸车辆厂及京汉铁路总工会旧址，用以纪念二七大罢工。原馆址位于江岸区二七路10号（解放大道2229号），1987年2月7日搬至现址，原纪念馆建筑群辟为江岸铁路文化宫。现新老馆址皆由中国铁路武汉局集团有限公司管理，纪念馆行政组织由武汉局集团直属。
intro_en: The Wuhan Erqi Memorial Hall is a social science-themed history museum located at No. 2499 Jiefang Avenue, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province, the People's Republic of China. The memorial hall opened on February 7, 1960, adjacent to Jiang'an Station, the Jiang'an Rolling Stock Plant, and the former site of the Beijing–Hankou Railway Trade Union Federation, in commemoration of the February 7 Strike. Its original site was at No. 10 Erqi Road (No. 2229 Jiefang Avenue), Jiang'an District; on February 7, 1987, it moved to its current location, and the original memorial building complex was converted into the Jiang'an Railway Workers' Cultural Palace. Both the old and new sites are now managed by China Railway Wuhan Group Co., Ltd., and the memorial hall is administratively under the direct authority of the Wuhan Group.
address_en: Jiangbei Expressway, Danshuichi Subdistrict, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei, China

Location: Sun Yat-sen Literature Museum
Located on Wenming Road in Guangzhou, it is the former site of the Sun Yat-sen Library of Guangdong Province. The museum specializes in collecting Dr. Sun Yat-sen's works, manuscripts, and related documents, and is an important venue for commemorating and studying Dr. Sun Yat-sen.

address: 湖北省武汉市武昌区积玉桥街道凤凰山小区

It was the venue of the Fifth National Congress of the CPC held in 1927. The museum displays historical documents and artifacts from the congress, and is an important revolutionary memorial site and red tourism attraction in Wuhan.

name_zh: 吴淞炮台湾湿地森林公园
address: 中华人民共和国G1503上海绕城高速
intro: 吴淞炮台湾湿地森林公园位于上海市宝山区，是上海最大的原生湿地公园。吴淞炮台湾原称杨家嘴，由于清政府曾在吴淞口建有水师炮台，故改称为现名。公园区域位于吴淞口的西北角，原为长江滩涂湿地，自20世纪60年代起，由废钢渣回填形成了公园的陆域部分。2005年，地方政府为改善区域生态环境，在此规划建造湿地森林公园。公园一期于2007年5月建成开放，二期则于2011年10月完工开放。
name_aliases: ['炮台湾湿地公园', '吴淞炮台湾湿地公园', '炮台湾湿地森林公园', '炮台湾公园']
intro_en: Wusong Paotaiwan Wetland Forest Park is located in Baoshan District, Shanghai, and is the largest native wetland park in Shanghai. Wusong Paotaiwan was originally called Yangjiazui; its present name was adopted because the Qing government once built a naval fort at the Wusongkou (Wusong Port) estuary. The park area lies at the northwestern corner of Wusongkou and was originally tidal wetland along the Yangtze River. From the 1960s onward, its land area was formed through backfilling with waste steel slag. In 2005, to improve the local ecological environment, the local government planned and built a wetland forest park here. The first phase of the park opened in May 2007, and the second phase was completed and opened in October 2011.
address_en: G1503 Shanghai Ring Expressway, People's Republic of China

address: 重庆市两江新区观音桥街道嘉陵江
intro: 早在1951年至1955年间，西南博物院便筹设“五馆一所”即历史馆、自然馆、革命馆、美术工艺馆、民族馆以及独立的研究所。1954年底，西南大区撤销。1955年6月西南博物院更名为重庆市博物馆。1955年，重庆市博物馆在八路军重庆办事处旧址筹建红岩革命纪念馆。历经3年筹建和重庆市博物馆代管，1958年5月1日红岩革命纪念馆正式对外开放。该馆的建成开放使原西南博物院规划的“五馆”中的“革命馆”变为现实。馆名“红岩革命纪念馆”是1959年由董必武题写。1964年，红岩革命纪念馆脱离重庆市博物馆独立，成为重庆市独立的文博单位 。
intro_en:
Location: Hongyan Revolutionary Memorial Hall

As early as 1951 to 1955, the Southwest Museum planned to establish the "Five Halls and One Institute," namely the History Hall, the Natural History Hall, the Revolutionary History Hall, the Arts and Crafts Hall, the Ethnic Studies Hall, and an independent research institute. At the end of 1954, the Southwest Greater Administrative Region was dissolved. In June 1955, the Southwest Museum was renamed the Chongqing Museum. In 1955, the Chongqing Museum began preparations to establish the Hongyan Revolutionary Memorial Hall at the former site of the Eighth Route Army's Chongqing Office. After three years of preparation under the trusteeship of the Chongqing Museum, the Hongyan Revolutionary Memorial Hall officially opened to the public on May 1, 1958. Its establishment and opening turned the "Revolutionary History Hall" of the "Five Halls" originally planned by the Southwest Museum into reality. The name "Hongyan Revolutionary Memorial Hall" was inscribed by Dong Biwu in 1959. In 1964, the Hongyan Revolutionary Memorial Hall became independent from the Chongqing Museum, becoming an independent cultural and museum institution in Chongqing.
address_en: Jialing River, Guanyinqiao Subdistrict, Liangjiang New Area, Chongqing

intro: 中國國民黨第一次全國代表大會舊址位於中國广州市越秀区大塘街道龙腾社区文明路215号大院内的钟楼，为全国重点文物保护单位。中國國民黨第一次全國代表大會於1924年1月20日至30日在该钟楼的礼堂内召开。礼堂现已恢复当时大会时的原状，正面的主席台上有孙中山画像，畫像左邊為中国国民党党旗、右邊為中华民国陆海军大元帅大本营（广东革命政府）的中華民國國旗，台下的座位全部贴有当时出席会议人员的编号和姓名。
intro_en: The Site of the First National Congress of the Chinese Kuomintang is located in the clock tower within the compound at No. 215 Wenming Road, Longteng Community, Datang Subdistrict, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, China. It is a Major Historical and Cultural Site Protected at the National Level. The First National Congress of the Chinese Kuomintang was held in the auditorium of this clock tower from January 20 to 30, 1924. The auditorium has now been restored to its original state at the time of the congress: on the rostrum at the front hangs a portrait of Sun Yat-sen, with the flag of the Chinese Kuomintang on its left and the national flag of the Republic of China used by the Grand Marshal's Office of the Army and Navy of the Republic of China (the Guangdong Revolutionary Government) on its right. All the seats below the rostrum bear labels with the numbers and names of those who attended the congress.

address: 上海市黄浦区南京东路街道延安高架路上海人民广场
intro: 中国共产党第二次全国代表大会会址，地处中国上海市静安区老成都北路7弄30号，是中国共产党第二次全国代表大会召开的地方。这次会议首次提出了党的民主革命纲领，制定了《中国共产党党章》，首次提出了党的统一战线思想，公开发表了《中国共产党宣言》。1951年，二大会址被确认。1959年5月26日及1977年12月7日，中国共产党第二次全国代表大会旧址先后两次被公布为上海市文物保护单位。此后该会址与平民女校原址一同被改造为二大会址纪念馆，并于2009年对公众免费开放。2013年3月5日，中国共产党第二次全国代表大会会址被国务院公布为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
intro_en: The Site of the Second National Congress of the Communist Party of China, located at Lane 7, No. 30, North Chengdu Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai, China, is where the Second National Congress of the Communist Party of China was held. At this congress, the Party's program of democratic revolution was put forward for the first time, the Constitution of the Communist Party of China was formulated, the Party's idea of a united front was first proposed, and the Manifesto of the Communist Party of China was publicly issued. In 1951, the site of the Second National Congress was identified. On May 26, 1959, and again on December 7, 1977, the site was designated a Shanghai Municipal Cultural Heritage Protection Site on two occasions. Later, the site, together with the former site of the Pingmin Girls' School, was converted into the Memorial Hall of the Second National Congress Site, which opened to the public free of charge in 2009. On March 5, 2013, the Site of the Second National Congress of the Communist Party of China was listed by the State Council as part of the seventh batch of Major Historical and Cultural Sites Protected at the National Level.
address_en: Memorial of the Site of the Second National Congress of the Communist Party of China

intro: 华北军区烈士陵园位于中国河北省石家庄市桥西区中山西路343号，是中华人民共和国国务院首批全国重点烈士纪念建筑物保护单位，中共中央宣传部“全国爱国主义教育示范基地”，中共中央宣传部等七部委“全国百家红色旅游经典景区”，中华人民共和国教育部、中华人民共和国民政部等六部委“全国中小学爱国主义教育基地”，亦是国家级国防教育示范基地。
康百万庄园位于河南省巩义市康店镇，庄园始建于明末清初。康百万家族前后十二代人在这个庄园生活，纵跨了明、清、民国三个时期400余年，庄园也从最初的半山腰一直建到了山顶。该庄园是一处典型的十七到十八世纪黄土高原上封建堡垒式的建筑。它背依邙山，面临洛水，从后人复制的庄园全貌图上看，庄园的所有建筑好像驮在一块巨型的龟背上，而龟的头部正好伸向河流，因而便有了“金龟探水”的称号。
始建于1956年。此馆馆名由周恩来题写，纪念中国共产党当时誉为“小延安”的重要根据地。 1988年，被中华人民共和国国务院公布为第三批全国重点文物保护单位。

益阳奥林匹克公园，简称益阳奥体公园，也被称为益阳奥体中心、益阳奥林匹克体育中心，位于中华人民共和国湖南省益阳市赫山区康复南路3号，现为国家4A级旅游景区。益阳奥林匹克公园是益阳市人民政府为承办2002年湖南省九运会专门修建的，2003年第五届城运会的部分比赛也在这里进行。公园东西宽约700米，南北长360米余，占地面积共500亩左右，建筑面积4.8万平方米，投资总额为1.62亿人民币。公园内的体育场馆有可容纳30000名观众的体育场、可容纳5000名观众的体育馆、可容纳800名观众的游泳馆和共20块训练场地的羽毛球训练馆，合称“一场三馆”。公园里还有露天游泳池、跳水池及集散广场、停车场、配套服务设施与室外健身活动场地等。

intro_en: The Deshou Palace Site is a Southern Song dynasty palace garden site in Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, and part of the ruins of the Southern Song capital Lin'an. Deshou Palace was originally the residence of Qin Hui, located north of the Southern Song imperial palace. It later became the palace of Emperor Gaozong and Emperor Xiaozong after their abdication, and was once known as the "Northern Palace." It gradually fell into ruin after the mid-to-late Southern Song period. The Southern Song Deshou Palace Site Museum now stands on the original site.

Location: Tianhe Park
Tianhe Park (formerly known as Dongjiao Park) is located between Zhongshan Avenue and Huangpu Avenue in Tianyuan Subdistrict, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, China. It is a park dominated by hills and woods. The park covers an area of 788,000 square meters, including 100,000 square meters of water, and is divided into five functional zones: the flower garden scenic area, sports and recreation area, senior activity area, forest leisure area, and logistics management area. More than 100 plant species are grown there, including trees, shrubs, flowers and grasses, palms, and bamboo, along with more than 20 century-old trees and over 10,000 square meters of aquatic forest. Its main attractions include Yuehui Garden, Deng Shichang's Memorial Tomb, the East Lake Pavilion, and Yuexiu Garden. Inside Tianhe Park there is Cuihu Lake, beside which is a matchmaking corner.

intro_en: The Dazu Rock Carvings are located in Dazu District, Chongqing, southwest China. They are cliff carvings dating from the late Tang to the early Song Dynasty, predominantly Buddhist in theme, among which the cliff sculptures of Baodingshan and Beishan are the most famous. The Dazu Rock Carvings are a renowned ancient stone carving art of China and were inscribed as a World Heritage Site in 1999. Their constituent parts, the Baodingshan cliff sculptures and the Beishan cliff sculptures, were respectively designated Major Historical and Cultural Sites Protected at the National Level in 1961.

intro: 侵华日军南京大屠杀遇难同胞纪念馆（ ， ）又称江东门纪念馆 ，是南京市人民政府为悼念侵华日军南京大屠杀遇难者而设立的遗址型专门史博物馆。馆址位于南京城西南江东门，是当年日军大屠杀的一处主要地点和遇难者丛葬地。纪念馆于1985年落成开放，经过1995年、2005年两次扩建，现占地约7.4万平方米、建筑面积2.5万平方米、展陈面积9800平方米，包括展览集会、遗址悼念、和平公园和馆藏交流等4个区域，其中展览陈列包括廣場陈列、遗骨陈列和史料陈列三部份。该馆收集了10000多份历史资料和文物，是国家一级博物馆、全国爱国主义教育示范基地。

intro_en: The Memorial Hall of the Victims in Nanjing Massacre by Japanese Invaders (also known as the Jiangdongmen Memorial Hall) is a site-specific museum of history established by the Nanjing Municipal People's Government to mourn the victims of the Nanjing Massacre committed by the invading Japanese troops. Located at Jiangdongmen in the southwest of Nanjing, the site was one of the major locations of the massacre and a mass burial ground for the victims. The memorial hall was completed and opened in 1985, and expanded in 1995 and 2005. It now covers an area of about 74,000 square meters, with a floor area of 25,000 square meters and an exhibition area of 9,800 square meters, comprising four zones: exhibitions and assemblies, site mourning, the Peace Park, and collection exchanges. Its exhibitions include three parts: square displays, remains displays, and historical document displays. The museum has collected more than 10,000 historical documents and artifacts, and is a National First-Grade Museum and a National Patriotism Education Demonstration Base.

Location: Chuansha Park
In July 1982, the Chuansha County People's Government decided to build the first park in its jurisdiction. On February 18, 1983, the Shanghai Capital Construction Commission approved the project proposal submitted by the Chuansha County Government. Construction of the park began on November 3, 1983, was completed in November 1985, and the park opened on December 1 under the name Chuansha Park. Not long after the park opened, the authorities felt that the park was small in area while receiving many visitors, and the Chuansha County Construction Bureau submitted a project proposal for the park's expansion. The expansion project of Chuansha Park broke ground in March 1991 and opened to the public on June 1 the following year. On August 18, 1993, the park raised funds for a third-phase project, which was completed by the end of 1994.

intro: 十字路水库，又称九龙湖 ，是中华人民共和国浙江省宁波市一个水库。水库位于镇海区九龙湖镇，于1958年开工，1959年因调整基建规模停工，1977年10月21日重新开工，1983年11月2日蓄水，1988年7月22日完工交付使用，为中型水库，水库总库容量2300万立方米，正常库容2030万立方米，集水面积10.4平方米 ，1991年起功能以供水、防洪为主，兼顾养殖和休闲旅游等，2002年进行大坝维修加固 ，原为镇海区饮用水源供应地 ，因自来水供水管网延伸完善，2015年停止生活供水，2016年转为向骆驼新城河网生态补水，2017年水功能区由原“十字路水库镇海饮用、景观娱乐用水区”调整为“十字路水库镇海景观娱乐用水区”，水环境功能区类型由原“饮用水水源一级保护区”调整为“景观娱乐用水区” ，2008年成为中国国家4A级旅游景区，2014年成为浙江省省级旅游度假区 。
intro_en: Shizilu Reservoir, also known as Jiulong Lake, is a reservoir in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, the People's Republic of China. Located in Jiulonghu Town, Zhenhai District, construction began in 1958, was halted in 1959 due to adjustments in infrastructure scale, resumed on October 21, 1977, began storing water on November 2, 1983, and was completed and put into use on July 22, 1988. It is a medium-sized reservoir with a total capacity of 23 million cubic meters and a normal storage capacity of 20.3 million cubic meters, with a catchment area of 10.4 square meters. Since 1991, its functions have focused primarily on water supply and flood control, while also serving aquaculture, leisure tourism, and other purposes. Dam maintenance and reinforcement were carried out in 2002. Originally a source of drinking water for Zhenhai District, it ceased supplying domestic water in 2015 as the tap water distribution network expanded and improved. In 2016, it shifted to providing ecological water replenishment to the river network of Luotuo New Town. In 2017, its water function zone was adjusted from the former "Shizilu Reservoir Zhenhai Drinking, Landscape and Recreation Water Zone" to "Shizilu Reservoir Zhenhai Landscape and Recreation Water Zone," and its water environment function zone type was changed from the former "Class-I Drinking Water Source Protection Zone" to "Landscape and Recreation Water Zone." It became a Chinese National 4A-Level Tourist Attraction in 2008 and a provincial-level tourist resort of Zhejiang Province in 2014.

name_en: Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor
address: 陕西省西安市临潼区秦陵街道演艺广场秦始皇帝陵
intro: 秦始皇帝陵是秦朝開國皇帝秦始皇的陵墓，位於中華人民共和國陝西省西安市臨潼區驪山北麓，秦代稱驪山園。陵園以封土和地下墓室為中心，設內外城垣，周圍分布禮制建築、陪葬墓、陪葬坑和修陵人墓地等遺存；核心地宮至今未作主動發掘。陵園東側的兵馬俑坑於1974年被發現，其陶俑、戰車和兵器展示了秦代軍事編制、雕塑和工藝。
intro_en:
Location: Mausoleum of Qin Shi Huang
The Mausoleum of Qin Shi Huang is the tomb of Qin Shi Huang, the founding emperor of the Qin dynasty. It is located at the northern foot of Mount Li in Lintong District, Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, People's Republic of China, and was known in the Qin dynasty as Lishan Garden. The mausoleum complex centers on the burial mound and underground tomb chamber, enclosed by inner and outer city walls, with surrounding remains including ritual buildings, attendant tombs, burial pits, and a cemetery for the tomb builders; the core underground palace has never been actively excavated. The Terracotta Army pits to the east of the mausoleum were discovered in 1974; their terracotta figures, chariots, and weapons showcase Qin dynasty military organization, sculpture, and craftsmanship.
address_en: Yanyi Square, Qinling Subdistrict, Lintong District, Xi'an, Shaanxi (Emperor Qinshihuang's Mausoleum Site)
